name: SingleStore
tagline: Distributed SQL running transactions, analytics, vector and full-text search in one engine on live data.
description: SingleStore (formerly MemSQL) is a distributed, MySQL-wire-compatible database whose default table type is a compressed columnstore on local disk that still supports fast seeks and updates; new writes are buffered in a rowstore segment, fully in-memory rowstore tables remain an option, and with unlimited storage older data tiers out to object storage. Built-in pipelines ingest continuously from Kafka, S3 and other sources, and the engine adds full-text and indexed vector search, so a single cluster can power customer-facing dashboards and AI features over fresh data. It is offered as Helios (managed, with a free shared tier) and as self-managed software. Since a 2025 growth buyout, private-equity firm Vector Capital holds a majority stake. Expect commercial licensing and some MySQL incompatibilities such as missing triggers.

pricing.notes: Helios has a free shared tier; dedicated workspaces billed per compute credit/hour; self-managed requires a license (free for small dev use).

scale.notes: Aggregator/leaf architecture with hash-sharded partitions; Helios separates storage onto object storage (bottomless); cross-region DR replication.

strengths: Columnstore with seekable, updatable segments serves both point lookups and large scans
Native pipelines ingest from Kafka, S3 and GCS with exactly-once semantics
Indexed vector search (HNSW/IVF, F16 vectors in 9.1) next to SQL and full-text
MySQL wire compatibility simplifies driver and BI tool support
Sub-second analytics on high-concurrency, customer-facing dashboards
MCP server and SQL AI functions let AI agents query and act on live data
weaknesses: Proprietary license; self-managed production use is costly
No triggers or materialized views; some MySQL syntax unsupported
Optional in-memory rowstore tables must fit in RAM; the default columnstore lives on local disk and tiers to object storage
Shard key and sort key choices strongly affect performance
useCases: Fraud detection and risk scoring on streaming data
Ad-tech and IoT ingestion with immediate querying
Hybrid vector plus keyword search for RAG
Apps and AI agents that read and write live business data
notIdealFor: Simple CRUD apps that fit in Postgres or MySQL
